units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:13:1">Koh. R. to II, 13</cite> <he>כשם שיש י׳ בין וכ׳</he> as there is a difference between light &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 5:8">Koh. V, 8</cite>) <he>אפי׳ דברים … י׳ למ״ת</he> even what thou deemest to be an addition to the original Law (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8:4">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>מיותרין</he>).

senses.gloss: superfluity, useless thing. Ib. אפי׳ … י׳ בעולם even what thou mightest deem to be mere useless creatures (Koh. R. to V, 8, a. e. מיותרין), v. יָתַר.
